svg.title: IGA pilot: detailed Azure development foundation and planned application architecture
svg.desc: East US 2 synthetic foundation: delegated Container Apps subnet and NAT egress; five private endpoints, eight private DNS zones, private PostgreSQL, Blob, Key Vault, ACR and monitoring; Service Bus Standard public endpoint exception; separate queue identities. Management checks passed and disposable resources were removed. Planned source collector, BFF and worker paths are separately shown and are not deployed or verified.
svg.text: IGA pilot — detailed Azure development architecture
Repository-backed view • East US 2 • Approved synthetic session of 2026-10-01 • ADR-0004
STATUS: 41 management checks passed after scoped repairs; disposable resources removed. G1 and live application paths remain unverified.
Azure subscription / development resource group — topology tested, then removed
Delegated to Microsoft.App/environments; attached to NAT Gateway.
Azure Container Apps environment: internal ingress; public network disabled.
Consumption profile; no apps, jobs, images or log exports deployed.
Five Approved private endpoints with service DNS zone groups:
4 Blob Storage 5 Azure Monitor Private Link Scope
Protected services are Azure PaaS; their endpoint NICs are in this subnet.
Eight private DNS zones link to this VNet; registration disabled.
Soft delete: 7 days; purge protection off.
32 GiB; no HA / geo backup / autogrow.
Customer artifact storage is future work.
Azure Monitor / Application Insights / Log Analytics
Azure Monitor Private Link Scope: private-only ingestion and query; 5 DNS zones.
Local authentication and public ingestion/query disabled; no exports or SDK collection.
Workspace retention: 30 days; daily ingestion cap: 1 GB (not a hard cost limit).
Application Insights table retention needs verification before collection is enabled.
Standard NAT and Standard public IP.
Actual address is excluded from this view.
Runtime egress has not been exercised.
Public endpoint exception; default deny; allow one NAT IPv4.
Entra-only; no SAS/local auth; minimum TLS 1.2.
Queue: duplicate detection and expiry dead lettering.
Separate sender and receiver; grants scoped only to synthetic-work.
No workload attachment or effective sender/receiver permission tests yet.
Approved application design — deployment and live tests still required
No VPN, peering or inbound listener.
Opaque work references in Service Bus.
Future paths above require app images, endpoint/trust configuration and effective permission, DNS, restore and denial tests. See existing views 01–04.
Original and repaired source revisions are retained in Git; exact digests in evidence JSON.
Green cards / solid routes: configured foundation; live traffic is not proven.
Purple dashed cards / routes: planned application layer; not an active deployment.
Retained: resource group, $50 monthly budget/alerts, inactive BFF registration, history.
Official Microsoft product SVGs embedded unmodified • Neutral shapes for logical components • Private DNS and source/template inventory: companion technical notes
